mapping_rule_applied: Mapping rule, quoted from rounds/briefs/PA-soif-licence-provenance.md: "a standard the publisher states is a free public download from a public body or treaty/alliance organisation (ICAO, ITU, NATO, EUROCONTROL) -> PUBLIC_GOVERNMENT; a standard released under an open licence or into the public domain by its author (CoT schema, if the page says so) -> OPEN; a standard sold or licensed by a private standards body or vendor (RTCA, NMEA) -> LICENSED; where one adapter rests on two standards with different postures, the MORE restrictive class governs and both readings are recorded; access restricted by classification/eligibility -> CONTROLLED; a vendor API description under the vendor's own terms -> M_TO_RULE". Applied: RTCA is named in the LICENSED branch and its own licence agreement forbids transfer to a third party; ICAO's PUBLIC_GOVERNMENT branch is conditioned on a free public download the publisher's own store refutes, so ICAO reads LICENSED here too. Both readings give the same class, so more-restrictive-governs is never reached. Confirmed by M 2026-09-07T21:39:33Z.
not_committed: This record is a reading of the publishers' pages, not an acquisition and not a pin: no document was downloaded into this repository, no hash of any standard is claimed, and no clause of any standard is transcribed beyond the quoted sentences below.
